notes.title: 2025/09/04 UpdateLog v0.18-0.20
notes.content:
Hello everyone, another day has passed and here are the new fixes.
If you still experience any unpleasant gameplay issues, please feel free to contact me.
[hr][/hr]Additions
Added DLSS support.

Added voice chat.

Added third-person mode.

Su Cola now collects juicers and pots.

Weekly utility bills must be paid; if not, lights and faucets will be unavailable.

Added more beautiful customer models.
[hr][/hr]Optimizations
Adjusted wall positions for better alignment.

Adjusted carpet collisions so carpets can be picked up.

Pearl Milk Tea recipe hint now includes a milk icon.

Optimized display for maximum pearl and ice cube limits.

Fixed an issue where ice cube colors were not restored after moving the ice machine.

Slightly reduced customer spawn rate in multiplayer mode.

Cooking pearls now requires only 90%+ water volume to complete.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where using the keyboard could switch the game into controller mode.

Fixed an issue where sinks and hands incorrectly showed held items.

Fixed a bug where two pots could be placed on the induction cooker.

Fixed an issue where the "not enough change" message only displayed for the host.

Fixed a bug where the sound of adding pearls was incorrectly played for the wrong player.

notes.title: Demo confirmed for Friday! Closed Test Recruitment Now 🍹
notes.content:
Hello, dear Store Managers! IceBao here, still “stirring code” behind the scenes!
We’re excited to officially announce that Bubble Tea Simulator Demo will launch on September 5th (Friday) on Steam.
Just one more week until you can finally open your shop! 🎉

Before that, we’ll be running a small-scale closed test. If you’d like to join, feel free to message me!

⚠️ Note: The test version may contain bugs that affect the experience. We’re looking for players willing to help us record issues. If that’s too much hassle, no worries—just wait for the Demo release on 9/5 (it’s only a week away).

🎮 Game Overview
Bubble Tea Simulator is a cozy yet detail-rich life & business simulation game:

Start with a small shop and gradually expand by mixing drinks, serving customers, managing inventory, decorating, and unlocking recipes. You can even open new branches!

The game blends free shop customization with a realistic drink-making process: carefully balance tea bases, milk/water, sugar, ice, fruit slices, pearls, and more.

Interact with a cast of NPCs (the grocery store owner, Furuide, Suke Le, street cats, etc.) and experience a vibrant little town slowly coming to life.

Supports both single-player and up to 4-player co-op multiplayer, plus achievements, events, and hidden Easter eggs.


👉 The Demo will showcase only part of the full content—more features are waiting in the official release!

notes.title: 2025/08/31 UpdateLog v0.06-0.07
notes.content:
Update Note
Hello everyone, another day has passed, and here are the new issues I’ve fixed.
If you still experience any unpleasant gameplay feelings, please contact me.
[hr][/hr]Improvements
Adjusted the number of customers, now linked to the popularity value based on player count.

Increased the UI size of ice and sugar indicators in the top-left corner.

Added controller threshold settings in the options menu (visible when a controller is connected).

Optimized the spawn point of lemon slices when cutting—no more exploding lemons.

Optimized the cashier sound attenuation settings.

Added a money deduction display in the settlement screen for orders not completed yesterday.

Renamed the large syrup container and large milk container.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where items picked up by a client were not visible to other members.

Fixed an issue where the displayed player name was incorrect when exiting the game.

Fixed an issue where business hours would automatically start when beginning a new day.

Fixed an issue where tutorial prompts remained in the scene even after skipping the tutorial.

Fixed an issue where recipes purchased by clients in the shop were not unlocked.

Fixed an issue where profit text animation in the settlement screen was too slow, causing the sound effect to loop endlessly.

Fixed an issue where object positions seen by clients were not synchronized with the host.

Fixed an issue where expansions were not saved after rejoining the game.

Fixed an issue where exterior walls were forced to change color.

Fixed an issue where, if a player disconnected during checkout, other players could not use the cashier desk.

Fixed an issue where the recipe screen on the client did not display currently listed recipes.

Fixed an issue where cup tickets could display the wrong information.

Fixed a mismatch in syrup capacity between host and clients.

Fixed an issue where clients saw incorrect money amounts given by customers.

Fixed an issue where the displayed spoilage days could become negative after cutting.

Fixed an issue where, under poor network conditions, drinks could be taken back immediately after being served.

Fixed an issue where the purchased green trash bin appeared as a purple trash bin.

notes.title: 2025/08/30 Update Log v0.005
notes.content:
Improvements
Updated player animations to make holding milk tea cups look more natural.

Added the ability to cancel from the settlement screen.

Added a sound effect when receiving money after giving recyclables to Sucola.

Increased daily gameplay time limit.

Added a warning when trying to serve drinks with insufficient water.

Syrup can no longer be added after reaching the normal sugar level.

Doubled the speed of Fresh Orange Juice making.

Optimized the UI for syrup, ice, and cup size display on the cup.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where some NPCs' clothing appeared missing on clients.

Fixed an issue where, when aiming at a cup, if another player changed the cup’s properties, the UI would update incorrectly.

Fixed an issue where players couldn’t see other players’ ping in the settlement screen.

Fixed an issue where hand animations did not reset after giving gifts to NPCs.

Fixed an issue where players couldn’t place items in a cup if it was already full, and this wasn’t reflected to all players.

Fixed an issue where the UI for a cup on the left side of the rack persisted even after placing a cup.

Possibly fixed an issue where placing cups into the sink at the same time could cause one to disappear.

Possibly fixed an issue where placing lemons onto the cutting board simultaneously could cause a lemon to vanish.

Fixed an issue where rotten items had no effect on customers.

Fixed an issue where rotten items would lose their rotten state when switching containers.

Fixed an issue where Double Pearl Milk Tea could not be unlocked.
[hr][/hr] v0.04 Fixes
Fixed an issue where Lemon Green Tea could not be crafted.

Fixed several issues related to spoilage logic.

Pearls no longer spoil.

Fixed an issue where placing green tea in a pot after clearing it still showed as spoiled.

Fixed an issue in multiplayer where clients could not discard trash from their hands.

Fixed an issue where, after viewing the sales analysis on the settlement screen, the next day could not be exited.

Fixed incorrect values for large syrup amounts.

Fixed an issue where a container that held one type of solution could not hold another type.

Fixed an issue where feeding a kitten once would instantly unlock a new recipe.

Fixed a freeze that could occur when the second player joined in multiplayer.

Fixed an issue where the cashier desk could sometimes disappear.
